# Parameters used in the intact walking simulation

[Intact walking results](README.md) · [Source and applied parameter tables](../../Documentation/parameter_tables.md)

The [parameter snapshot](Model_Parameters_Used/README.md) records the values used
for this calculation. The [parameter tables](../../Documentation/parameter_tables.md)

The [configuration guide](../../Documentation/configuration.md) shows where to edit
